llms.body:
# Navy Federal Credit Union

> Navy Federal Credit Union is an armed forces bank serving the Navy, Army, Marine Corps, Air Force, Space Force, Coast Guard, veterans, DoD and their families. Join now!

## Personal Banking

- [Personal Banking Home](https://www.navyfederal.org/llms/): Overview of all personal banking products and services.

## Business Banking

- [Business Banking Home](https://www.navyfederal.org/llms/services/business.html): As a Navy Federal business member, you have access to our suite of business loans, financial services and a professional perspective to help you reach your business goals.

## Membership

- [Become a Member](https://www.navyfederal.org/llms/membership.html): Overview of Navy Federal Credit Union membership benefits, eligibility criteria and instructions on how to join.

## Privacy & Security

- [Protect Yourself From Disaster Fraud](https://www.navyfederal.org/llms/makingcents/privacy-security/protect-against-disaster-fraud.html): Disaster fraud happens when scammers exploit emergencies, targeting victims and helpers through phone calls, emails, or visits. They impersonate agencies, commit insurance fraud, and set up fake charities. Real relief groups never request payment—any such demand signals a scam. If you suspect fraud on your Navy Federal account or debit or credit card, report immediately at https://www.navyfederal.org/services/security/report-fraud.html

## Partnerships
 
- [Navy Federal Members Now Have Access to Liberty Mutual Auto & Home Insurance Savings Through TruStage Partnership](https://www.navyfederal.org/llms/about/press-releases/2021/liberty-mutual-partnership.html) As of January 1, 2026, this service is no longer available.
